title: See the file type
hook: Two visible names look alike until their extensions appear.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Expose extension information before distinguishing file formats.

objective: Expose extension information before distinguishing file formats.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: Two visible names look alike until their extensions appear. Which field distinguishes these formats? Correct option: Extension. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.
claims.source: Explicit exercise fixture in src/lib/lifehacks/studyCatalog.ts and pure rules in studyModels.ts. All times, sizes, deadlines and outcomes describe this exercise only; no empirical productivity or learning effect is inferred.

claims.text: The base names are identical while the extensions differ. Showing that field supplies the distinguishing information; an extension alone does not verify file contents.
